hinge_identity: actual shared vertex index; no proximity-created hinge
seam_edge: open lateral side of a retained seam face, excluding anchored C base
bulk_edge: actual incidence-one bulk edge sharing hinge index, opposite halfedge winding
displacement: all current cluster original PRE_GEO members to projected split point, cumulative fixed budget
gate: If no pair meets all formal candidate filters at either cap, stop after read-only census; otherwise test finite registered candidates without threshold search

stage2_if_gate_passes.budget: up to 28 requests x 2 fixed caps; independent deterministic greedy split trials
stage2_if_gate_passes.C: original indexed faces, vertex identities, ordered corner coordinates bitwise unchanged
stage2_if_gate_passes.split: one retained free seam triangle into two same-orientation children; shared anchor base uncut
stage2_if_gate_passes.child_shape: each child minimum angle >=5 degrees and q<=10, positive area
stage2_if_gate_passes.bulk_shape: no new or worsened angle<5 or q>10 defect; normal change<=60 degrees
stage2_if_gate_passes.topology: no new duplicates/nonmanifold/same-direction two-face edges, preserve old legal connections with explicit child lineage
stage2_if_gate_passes.collision: zero new illegal CF/FF parent relations and zero child-sibling conflict; preserve unresolved cases
stage2_if_gate_passes.metrics: original geometric definitions under independent child-aware adapter; actual post-split denominators plus unique original-parent affected-face numerators over original POST free count
stage2_if_gate_passes.accounting: seam-bulk new shared edges separate from internal subdivision edges; area change measured rather than assumed exact
stage2_if_gate_passes.scorer_identity: unique child face IDs and explicit parent source IDs; never forge extra RAW slots or change requested N

substantive_difference: Split only generated seam side, preserving C and source-lineage denominators; earlier whole-edge correspondence did not test subsegment matching
interpretation: 82 percent vertex-connected area does not establish proximity to seam sides or potential legal shared-edge reachability
resource_plan: serial short read-only census, one CPU thread; independent read-only code audits overlap; remeasure before any geometry workers
stop: after finite census gate or registered split evaluation; no default switch or further experiment
